name: ENL 2023: Entwicklung von Natur und Landschaft, Thüringen

funder.name: Thüringer Ministerium für Umwelt, Energie und Naturschutz (TMUEN)

summary: Thuringia grants for habitat restoration, biotope networks, species protection, Natura 2000 management plans and visitor guidance, plus river and floodplain renaturation. Run in two steps: a project sketch first, then an application on invitation.

calls.label: Annual project-sketch round (by 1 September of the previous year)
calls.recurring: Project sketch due by 1 September of the year before the project; further calls if budget allows.
